text:
Jack Roslovic is on his sixth NHL team, and in Toronto he has found a spot that suits him. Eight goals and 18 points in 18 games, a career-high 7-game point streak that ended against Montreal, and, as Toronto Hockey Daily put it, he is "quietly flying beside Auston Matthews."

The flying part is literal. His top speed ranks in the 99th percentile and his bursts over 20 mph in the 98th. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 54% of his shots coming off the rush last season.

The scoring is the part to doubt. Eight goals on 4.8 expected goals, shooting 17% against 15% last season: the chances are real, the finishing rate rarely lasts. His points per 60 sit well above what our range expects from him. Toronto Hockey Daily also reported he left the Canadiens game after a high stick, so watch his status. Our range has him at 50 to 73 points.
headline: Roslovic is flying beside Matthews. Can it last?
